name: Quick Legs
text: You have six highly coordinated legs, so it's easy to get around the battlefield. You Step up to three times.

name: Quick Polyp Repopulation
text: The polyps that form your exoskeleton adapt and regrow more quickly than usual. Reduce the DC of flat checks to end persistent damage on you by 2.

name: Quick Recognition
text: You Recognize Spells swiftly. Once per round, you can Recognize a Spell using a skill in which you're a master as a free action.

name: Quick Repair
text: You fix broken items quickly. You can Repair an item in 1 minute rather than 10 minutes, and in half the time under ideal conditions.

name: Quick Squeeze
text: You Squeeze 5 feet per round (10 feet on a critical success). If you're legendary in Acrobatics, you Squeeze at full Speed.

name: Quick Stow
text: Frequency once per round You're trained in the trick of quickly moving items into your cheek pouches. You Interact to store one held item in your cheek pouches (provided it fits).

name: Quick Study
text: Trigger You roll initiative. You can take the scholar out of the library, but you can't take the library out of the scholar—even when matters turn violent. You can attempt to Recall Knowledge against a creature you're observing within 30 feet.

name: Quick Swap
text: Trigger You're wielding a two-handed weapon, and an enemy creature moves adjacent to you. You can switch weapons in stressful situations so that you quickly set yourself up to punish incoming foes. You stow your current weapon and draw another two-handed weapon. If you have multiple sets of arms, you can instead Switch Hands.

You can switch weapons in stressful situations so that you quickly set yourself up to punish incoming foes. You stow your current weapon and draw another two-handed weapon. If you have multiple sets of arms, you can instead Switch Hands.

name: Quick Swim
text: You Swim 5 feet farther on a success and 10 feet farther on a critical success, to a maximum of your Speed. If you're legendary in Athletics, you gain a swim Speed equal to your Speed.

name: Quick Unlock
text: You can Pick a Lock using 1 action instead of 2.

name: Quickened Casting
text:
Frequency once per day

You accelerate your spellcasting. If your next action is to cast a mystic cantrip or a mystic spell that's at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank mystic spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

name: Quickened Casting
text:
Frequency once per day

You accelerate your spellcasting. If your next action is to cast a mystic cantrip or a mystic spell that's at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank mystic spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

name: Quickened Casting (Starfinder)
text: Frequency once per day You accelerate your spellcasting. If your next action is to cast a mystic cantrip or a mystic spell that's at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank mystic spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

name: Quickened Processor
text: You can quickly identify your surroundings, and you can use that information to your advantage while in the midst of danger or while in the process of piloting vehicles in hazardous situations. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks for initiative rolls and a +2 circumstance bonus to Piloting checks for initiative rolls.

name: Quiet Allies
text: You're skilled at moving with a group. When you are Avoiding Notice and your allies Follow the Expert, you and those allies can roll a single Stealth check, using the lowest modifier, instead of rolling separately. This doesn't apply for initiative rolls.

name: Quine Relay
text: [free-action] Trigger: your turn begins. You immediately gain the effects of the Sustain a Spell action, extending the duration of one of your active technomancer spells.

name: Quip
text: Trigger A creature within 30 feet is damaged by an ally's Strike. You follow up on your ally's success by hurling a cunning, well-timed taunt at a foe they wounded. Attempt to Demoralize the triggering creature.

name: Quip
text:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet is damaged by an ally's Strike.

You follow up on your ally's success by hurling a cunning, well-timed taunt at a foe they wounded. Attempt to the triggering creature.

name: Radiant Bond
text: When you Transfer Vitality, you can select any number of bonded allies to transfer to, though the total maximum number of Hit Points you can transfer doesn't increase.

name: Radiant Bond
text: When you , you can select any number of bonded allies to transfer to, though the total maximum number of Hit Points you can transfer doesn't increase.

name: Radiant Zone
text: The reality you conjure is much brighter than your own. The area of your quantum field becomes bright light. Creatures who begin their in your quantum field must attempt a fortitude|against:witchwarper|options:area-effect,inflicts:dazzled,inflicts:blinded save against your class DC; creatures with light blindness treat their result as one step worse. Success The creature is unaffected. Failure The creature is Dazzled for 1 round. Critical Failure The creature is Blinded for 1 round, then dazzled for 1 round.

name: Radiant Zone
text:
The reality you conjure is much brighter than your own. The area of your quantum field becomes bright light. Creatures who begin their turn in your quantum field must attempt a save against your class DC; creatures with light blindness treat their result as one step worse.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is for 1 round, then dazzled for 1 round.

name: Radiation Resistant
text: You're resistant to radiation due to long-term exposure triggering changes in your biology. You gain poison resistance equal to your level against damage from radiation effects and a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation effects.

name: Radioactive Core
text: You've been exposed to so much radiation that you become radioactive. When a creature Strikes you with a melee unarmed attack or Grabs you, it takes ] damage.

name: Radioactive Resistance
text: Maybe it was your environment, genetics, or even something you ate, but you've developed a resistance to radiation. You gain resistance to fire and poison damage from radiation effects equal to half your level and a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.

name: Raise Crystalline Strands
text: Frequency once per day Trigger An enemy's Strike against you is a critical hit. You position your fortified crystalline hair to absorb some of the blow from an otherwise lethal attack. The triggering attack deals only the amount it would deal on a hit (typically full damage instead of double damage). Any other effects caused by a critical hit still occur. It takes a day for your shattered hair to regrow, and until it does, you take a –2 circumstance penalty to Diplomacy checks with other moyishuus.

name: Raise Wing
text: Your wings are mighty parapets, and you can raise them to protect you from harm. If you spend one action to Raise a single Wing, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the beginning of your next turn. If you spend two actions to Raise both Wings, you instead gain standard Cover, granting you the usual +2 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saves against area effects until the beginning of your next turn, though you don't get a bonus to Hide or Sneak behind your own wings. While gaining standard cover from the two-action version of Raise Wing, you aren't off-guard to flanking creatures of your level or lower, though they can still help their higher-level allies flank you. If you use Wing Deflection while benefiting from Raise Wing, they synergize for a greater effect. You gain a +3 circumstance bonus to AC from Wing Deflection, instead of a +2 circumstance bonus, or a +4 circumstance bonus to AC if you spent two actions to Raise both Wings.

name: Range Sniper
text: You've trained to engage your foes from afar and leverage your keen vision to improve your accuracy. You reduce the penalty for attacking beyond your first range increment by 1, to a minimum of 0. If you're in a vacuum, you instead reduce the penalty for attacking beyond your first range increment by 2, to a minimum of 0. In addition, you gain the Line Up the Shot action.

name: Rapid Excavations
text: You drill through the earth with great speed. During your daily preparations, select an implement you use for mining, like a pick, drill, laser, or razing weapon. You gain a burrow Speed of 15 feet while holding or wielding the item, or 20 feet if the item expends ammunition or charges when used.

name: Rapid Growth
text: Your growth processes accelerate dramatically. You gain fast healing 1, and when in an area of bright natural light, this increases to fast healing 2.

name: Rapid Mantel
text: You easily pull yourself onto ledges. When you Grab an Edge, you can pull yourself onto that surface and stand. You can use Athletics instead of a Reflex save to Grab an Edge. If you Climb or Leap to within 5 feet beneath the top of an edge, you can pull yourself onto the surface and stand as part of that action.

name: Rapturous Revel
text:
Frequency once per day

You bring forth a reverie either from Elysium, if you're a havoc dragon, or from your own innate desire to party, if you're an indigo dragon, in order to inspire allies, confuse foes, and befriend onlookers. A surge of inspiration and joy surrounds you in a 30-foot emanation filled with bright colors and beautiful music. For each target you can perceive in the area, choose whether to grant them a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks for 1 minute, attempt to confuse them, or attempt to charm them.

Effect: Rapturous Revel

If you attempt to confuse a target, the target must succeed at a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or be Confused for 1 round, or confused for 1 minute on a critical failure. Confused creatures engage in raucous laughter in addition to other effects of confusion.

If you attempt to charm a target, the target must succeed at a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies have threatened it or taken a hostile action against it recently, or become friendly to you for 1 minute, or helpful for 1 minute on a critical failure, and it can't take hostile actions against you; the charm effect has the incapacitation trait.

name: Rascal-Light
text: You have a free tactical flashlight built into your LFAN. Using this flashlight doesn't interfere with your ability to use your hands or your LFAN to interact with or hold other objects. Additionally, you gain the Digital Diversion skill feat and can Create a Diversion using Computers instead of Deception by rapidly manipulating the settings on your flashlight. When you do, Create a Diversion gains the visual trait. [[/act create-a-diversion skill=computers traits=visual variant=gesture]] [[/act create-a-diversion skill=computers traits=visual variant=trick]] [[/act create-a-diversion skill=computers traits=visual variant=distracting-words]]

name: Rat Race
text: You channel your ancestral ability to maximize movement in any situation. You Stride three times.

name: Rat Retinal HUD
text: You've had your retinas modified, granting you a permanent HUD that takes reads on your surroundings. You gain an autorecognition lens augmentation that can't be removed and that doesn't use an augmentation slot. You become trained in Computers. If you would automatically become trained in Computers (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. Once per day, you can Access Infosphere as a 3-action activity on a creature you're observing with your HUD whose name you've identified.

name: Ravenous Restoration
text: You have a colossal appetite for a creature your size, and you find that a good meal always hits the spot. Once per day, you can eat a snack or meal as a 10-minute activity. When you do, you regain a number of Hit Points equal to 1d6 plus your level ((1d6 + @actor.level)[healing]).

name: Razor Scrap
text: Your temporary shells are dangerous if shattered. If a creature breaks or destroys your shield with an unarmed attack or melee weapon without the reach trait, it takes ] damage from the shrapnel.

name: Reach Spell
text: You can extend the range of your spells. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell's range by 30 feet. As is standard for increasing spell ranges, if the spell normally has a range of touch, you extend its range to 30 feet.

name: Reach Spell
text: You can extend the range of your spells. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell's range by 30 feet. As is standard for increasing spell ranges, if the spell normally has a range of touch, you extend its range to 30 feet.

name: Reach Spell (Starfinder)
text: You can extend the range of your spells. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell's range by 30 feet. As is standard for increasing spell ranges, if the spell normally has a range of touch, you extend its range to 30 feet.

name: Reactive Firewall
text: [reaction] (once per hour) Requirements: your gear is overclocked. A wall of data shields you: the attacker must roll its attack roll a second time and take the lower result.

name: Reactive Flicker
text:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger An enemy's Strike or targeted effect would hit you.
You try to time your temporal displacement to avoid attacks. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC against the triggering attack, potentially causing a successful hit into a miss or a critical success into a success. If this changes the result of the attack, you can Step up to 10 feet.

name: Reactive Shapeshifting
text: Trigger You roll initiative. You can change at a moment's notice. You Change Shape and gain a +2 circumstance bonus on the triggering initiative roll if you used Deception to roll initiative.

name: Read 'Em Like A Book
text: Trigger An enemy you can sense rolls for initiative. You've mastered reading people in all circumstances, even before a fight breaks out. Roll Perception to [[/act sense-motive]] against your target. If you succeed, your initiative roll is equal to the target's initiative plus 1. If you critically succeed, your initiative is equal to the target's initiative plus 2, and the target is Off-Guard to you until the start of its turn.

name: Read Lips
text: You can read lips of others nearby who you can clearly see. The language read must be one that you know. When you're at your leisure, you can do this automatically. In encounter mode or when attempting a more difficult feat of lipreading, you're Fascinated and Off-Guard during each round in which you focus on lip movements, and you must succeed at a Society check (DC determined by the GM) to successfully read someone's lips.

name: Read Mental Dossier
text: To you, the mind is an open book. You can cast as an innate occult spell once per day. Use your Intelligence as your spellcasting attribute for this innate spell if its modifier is higher than your Charisma modifier.

name: Read the Threads
text:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You are about to roll initiative.

You read the flow of time in order to react before anyone else. You roll Dimension of Time Lore for initiative, with a +2 circumstance bonus.

name: Ready for Anything
text: Frequency once per day Lacking the additional protections and advantages granted by augmentations that many others take for granted, you have nurtured a habit of being prepared for every eventuality. You swap the skill feat granted to you by for another skill feat you qualify for.

name: Ready For Trouble
text: You learned your lesson after one-too-many encounters with deadly mechanisms and rigged ruins. You gain the Danger Awareness feat. You can use Delve Lore to disarm traps from alien or historically significant locations.

name: Ready Reload
text: Requirements You're wielding a two-handed ranged weapon with a reload of 2 or more, and your last action was an attack that expended ammo from the weapon. You know that reloading a weapon can be a delicate process, but you've mastered how to do so in the middle of combat, starting while still in the act of firing your weapon. Reduce your weapon's reload cost by 1, then Interact to reload your weapon. Unlike most Interact actions, you don't need a free hand to reload your ranged weapon in this way.

name: Ready Reload
text:
Requirements You're wielding a two-handed ranged weapon with a reload of 2 or more, and your last action was an attack that expended ammo from the weapon.

You know that reloading a weapon can be a delicate process, but you've mastered how to do so in the middle of combat, starting while still in the act of firing your weapon. You Interact to reload your weapon twice. Unlike most Interact actions, you don't need a free hand to reload your ranged weapon in this way.

name: Ready to Roll
text: Trigger You roll initiative. You instinctively react to trouble by directing your allies to act at the exact moment their intervention would matter most. Issue a 1-action directive.

text:
Trigger You roll initiative.

You instinctively react to trouble by directing your allies to act at the exact moment their intervention would matter most. Issue a 1-action directive.

name: Reality Anchor
text: You anchor a creature within 30 feet to its current timeline. Once per round as a free action, you can grant an ally a +2 status bonus to one saving throw as reality stabilizes around them.

name: Reality Collapse
text: You fold overlapping realities onto a single point of devastation. Once per day, spend 3 actions to create a 30-foot burst at a point within 120 feet. All creatures inside take 10d6 untyped force damage (Reflex save for half) as competing timelines collide.

name: Realized Epiphany
text: Frequency once per minute You've come to learn that your vitality network isn't just a manifestation of your magic, it's a metaphysical representation of your connection. If your next action is to cast an epiphany spell, you can expend 20 Hit Points from your vitality network to cast it, rather than spending a Focus Point.

name: Realized Epiphany
text:
Frequency once per minute

You've come to learn that your vitality network isn't just a manifestation of your magic, it's a metaphysical representation of your connection. If your next action is to cast an epiphany spell, you can expend 20 Hit Points from your vitality network to cast it, rather than spending a Focus Point.

name: Really Get Em!
text: You gain the Lead by Example benefit for your Get 'Em! directive, except you and your allies get a +2 status bonus to damage on both the initial and subsequent Strikes.

name: Rebuke Cataclysm
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You critically fail a saving throw. You were taught not to give up, even in a situation as dire as the end of your home world. You treat your critical failure as a failure. If you begin as a result of the failure, your first recovery check has a DC equal to 5 + your current dying value.

name: Recite Gap History
text: You can speak a truth about the Gap that causes you to vanish from others' perceptions temporarily. You gain Disappearance as an 8th-rank occult innate spell that you can cast only on yourself once per day.

name: Recode Creation
text: You can read some of your story in the grand narrative of all creation, setting a metaphysical bookmark in case you lose your place. Once per day, when you would die, you instead cease to physically exist for 1 minute. At the end of this duration, your body is rewritten into existence from the grand narrative, appearing at full Hit Points in the location you disappeared from. Do not increase the value of your wounded condition.

name: Recognize Spell

meta.Prerequisites: ["trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion"]

text: You can identify spells as they're being cast. You can attempt to identify a spell being cast as a reaction, even without any action expenditure.

name: Recurring Fear
text: You are able to stoke your frightful presence more often. You can use Frightful Presence once per hour, instead of once per day.

name: Red Eye
text: Your eyes burn with a red hue and glow like embers when in areas of darkness or shade. You gain darkvision.

name: Redemption
text: While your cousins, bliss dragons, tend to be peaceful in their pursuit of redemption, as a guardian, you know things sometimes get violent, and so you have gained the supernatural power to grant a fallen ally or foe a second chance. Once per week, you can cast a 6th-, 7th-, or 8th-level Raise Dead as an innate divine spell. At 19th level, you can also choose to cast a 9th-level raise dead. The dead creature can choose whether to accept your offer of redemption and a new life, in which case in addition to the other effects of raise dead, the creature's alignment changes one step towards good, or one step towards lawful if it was already good. If the dead creature refuses the bargain in order to preserve its alignment, the diamonds in the spell's cost aren't consumed in the casting, and it doesn't cost you your weekly use of your innate raise dead.

name: Refined Chassis
text: You further upgrade your drone: it becomes a graceful or burly companion.

name: Reflect Spell
text: When you successfully use Counterspell to counteract a spell that affects targeted creatures or an area, you can turn that spell's effect back on its caster. The reflected spell affects only the original caster, who can attempt a save and use defenses as normal.

name: Reflecting Scales
text:
Frequency once per hour

You concentrate energy into your scales, protecting yourself and storing power that you can use to unleash a powerful burst. Choose acid, cold, fire, force, electricity, mental, poison, sonic, or spirit damage. You gain resistance 5 against the damage type that you chose for 5 minutes. Your scales' color change depending on the damage type you chose, usually to the color of a type of dragon or other scaled creature associated with that damage type. The scales store up energy as they protect you. Keep track of how much damage the scales have prevented each time you use Reflecting Scales. While the effect lasts, you can use Reflecting Scales again (ignoring its frequency entry) to explode with all the stored energy in a 20-foot emanation. This explosion deals 1d6 damage of the chosen type to all creatures in the area for every 10 damage the scales prevented, to a maximum of 10d6 damage if the scales prevented 100 damage) with a Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Once you do so, the Reflecting Scales effect ends early.

name: Reflective Notes
text: You concentrate energy into your scales, protecting yourself and storing power that you can use to unleash a powerful burst. You can cast Reflective Scales once per hour as an innate spell of your heritage's tradition.

name: Reflexive Hypotheses
text: No matter how engrossed you are in other tasks, part of your mind can't help but stay curious about your surroundings. You become trained in a Lore skill about a specific environment, planet, plane, or settlement. You can move at full Speed while using the Investigate activity. Choose one of the following: Arcana, Nature, Occultism, Religion, or Society. While using any other exploration activity, you also Investigate your surroundings, though only to Recall Knowledge using the chosen skill and any Lore skills you have.

name: Refresh Cirrisensors
text: Frequency once per round Your cirrisensors regenerate and help you shrug off afflictions. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on you: , , , sickened, or stupefied. This counteract check uses your Fortitude modifier against the target's DC, and your counteract rank is equal to half your level rounded up. If you didn't counteract the effect, but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, you instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's in this way. This effect can't cure curses, diseases, or other long-term afflictions with these conditions as part of their normal state, but it can temporarily remove the condition. If the underlying affliction isn't treated, any counteracted conditions return after 24 hours.

name: Regenerative Blood
text: You use ritualistic prayer to gain supercharged regenerative abilities, giving your blood the power to heal wounds and regrow lost limbs, even when applied to others. You can cast Regenerate as a 7th-rank primal innate spell twice per day.

name: Regional Manager
text: You can use the reaction to help an ally, even if you haven't prepared to do so. If one or more of your allies are your employees, after you Aid an ally at a skill check that doesn't have the attack trait, you can also Aid any other ally who's also one of your employees who attempts the same skill check for the same purpose that round as a free action rather than a reaction. An ally is also your employee as long as they spend at least one day of Downtime per week Earning Income on behalf of your company. They keep any income they earn, but on a Critical Failure your company's reputation might suffer.

name: Release Radiation
text: Frequency once per hour Like the star or supernova you wish to emulate, you've learned to focus and release bursts of radiation. All non-novian creatures in a must attempt a fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Critical Success The creature is unaffected. Success The creature is Sickened 1 for 1 round. Failure The creature is Sickened 2 for 2 rounds. Critical Failure The creature is sickened 2 for 1 minute.

name: Relentless Aim
text: You take careful aim with your shots so that your bullets ricochet off solid surfaces. When determining if you have line of effect to a target you've aimed at, you can choose one solid surface within your weapon's first range increment to ricochet your shot to hit your target; determine line of effect from the chosen ricochet surface, rather than your location. If the creature is Undetected, the GM still rolls a flat check in secret to see if you missed, but the flat check becomes DC 5.

name: Relentless Aim
text: You take careful aim with your shots so that your bullets ricochet off solid surfaces. When determining if you have line of effect to a target you've aimed at, you can choose one solid surface within your weapon's first range increment to ricochet your shot to hit your target; determine line of effect from the chosen ricochet surface, rather than your location. If the creature is , the GM still rolls a flat check in secret to see if you missed, but the flat check becomes DC 5.

name: Relentless Endurance
text: Frequency once per hour Trigger You take damage. You bounce back stronger after a hit, ready to continue the fight. You gain 1d8+4 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute. Increase this amount by 1d8+4 at 6th level and every 4 levels thereafter.

name: Relentless Endurance
text:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You take damage.

You bounce back stronger after a hit, ready to continue the fight. You gain 1d8+4 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute. Increase this amount by 1d8+4 at 6th level and every 4 levels thereafter.

name: Relentless Roller
text: Frequency once per hour Trigger You would become Clumsy, Enfeebled, Slowed, or Suppressed. Faced with helplessness, you channel your restlessness into a relentless desire to always move faster even when you are feeling sluggish. You gain a +20-foot status bonus to all your Speeds for 1 round.

name: Relentless Tentacles
text: Requirements You used your last action this turn to [[/act grapple]] a creature within your reach. You bring additional limbs to bear, ensuring that you either ensnare your target or wrap your captured prey in additional tentacles. Attempt to Grapple the target, but the attempt's multiple attack penalty is only –3 if it's your second attack on your turn or –6 if it's the third or subsequent attack. If the target is already Grabbed or Restrained by you, replace Grapple's effects with the following. Critical Success If your target was grabbed, it's now restrained until the end of your next turn unless you move or your target Escapes. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Athletics DC to resist the target's attempts to Escape. Success You wrap additional limbs around the target. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Athletics DC to resist the target's attempts to Escape, and you increase the flat check DC it must attempt when attempting a manipulate action to 7. Failure You fail to wrap additional limbs around your target, but it remains grabbed or restrained.

name: Reliable Expert
text: Your knowledge of a specific subject is especially reliable thanks to the brain you've dedicated to thinking about it. You gain the Additional Lore feat and the Assurance feat for the chosen Lore. Once per day when you forgo rolling a skill check using Assurance for the associated Lore, you can choose to receive a result of 13 + your proficiency bonus (instead of 10 + your proficiency bonus).

name: Reliable Grace
text: You have exceptional control over your body. You can use Natural Grace once per hour, rather than once per day.

name: Religious Talisman
text: You can construct and bless a religious symbol of your deity in 10 minutes. While such talismans are traditionally scraps of paper with a religious symbol drawn on them, they can take many forms, including body art, a sticker, or even a virtual emoji. You can create a talisman only for yourself and for the deity you worship. As long as you continue to engage in activities that match your deity's edicts you gain a +1 status bonus to initiative rolls. If you violate your deity's anathema, the talisman is destroyed, and you take a –1 status penalty to initiative rolls and Perception checks until you complete an Atone ritual.

name: Remix World's Rhythm
text: Whether through intense musical training, magical insight, or Meyel's divine blessing, you can feel the rhythm of the world around you and tug on time's chords to manipulate its melody and flow. You gain Haste and Slow as 3rd-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these spells once per day.

name: Remote Access
text: You know how to probe computer systems with your mind as easily as others might handle a hacking toolkit. You can communicate wirelessly with technological devices within 10 feet, allowing you to attempt Computers checks on these devices without a user interface or hacking toolkit. If you can already attempt Computers checks at range, you increase the distance that you can do so by an additional 10 feet.

name: Remote Operation
text: You can use a hacking toolkit to operate a vehicle without being inside it — including to Drive it — and can remotely operate a vehicle or machine you can see within 30 feet, at the GM's discretion.

name: Repair Module
text: Frequency once per day You trigger your body's self-repair programming, stimulating your body's nanites to heal your wounds. You gain fast healing equal to half your level for 1 minute. While Repair Module is active, if you use Nanite Surge or Nanite Form, this fast healing ends.

name: Repeating Role
text: Just like giving an encore performance of one of your most iconic roles, you learn how to better use your training off the set. You can now use Role Repertoire once per hour instead of once per day.

name: Repository of Divinity
text: The writings on your shell expand to include a vast array of knowledge about the entities found across the multiverse. Choose either Summon Celestial or Summon Fiend. Once per day, you can cast the chosen spell as a divine innate spell heightened to half your level rounded up. The creature summoned must match the theme of the philosophical treatises marked on your shell, such as a creature with the angel trait if your treatise is on enlightenment achieved through virtuous acts.

name: Reptile Speaker
text: While the claim that dragons might be reptiles is preposterous, you have a strong affinity for scaly animals nonetheless. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals that are reptiles. The GM determines which animals count for this ability.

name: Repurpose Mystic Power
text: Your polyps can absorb hostile magic and repurpose it to fuel your body. Whenever you succeed at a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to double the spell's rank, or equal to the level of the magical effect if it isn't a spell. These temporary Hit Points last until the end of your next turn.

name: Researched Spell Resistance
text: While humans lacks the innate magic of other ancestries, they makes up for it with the ability to learn the mystical arts and protect themselves from magical threats. Choose one of the four spell traditions in which you're an expert in its corresponding skill (arcane for Arcana, primal for Nature, occult for Occultism, and divine for Religion). You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all saving throws against spells and effects with the corresponding tradition's trait. If you are or become a master in a skill corresponding to a previously chosen spell tradition, you can choose another tradition in which you're trained in its corresponding skill. You can repeat this process until you've chosen all four spell traditions.

name: Resilient Polyps
text: Thanks to your focus on your body's health as it grows new polyps, your polyps are especially resilient. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level. When you have the dying condition, the DC of your recovery checks is equal to 9 + your dying value (instead of 10 + your dying value). If you also have the Toughness feat, the Hit Points gained from it and this feat are cumulative, and the DC of your recovery checks is equal to 6 + your dying value.

name: Resonant Pulse
text: You release stored harmonic energy in a burst. Once per day as a 2-action activity, you emit a 15-foot cone of sonic force dealing 2d6 sonic damage (basic Fortitude save, DC = 10 + level + CON modifier).

name: Resonant Weapon
text: You release a pulse of spiritual energy into one weapon you're holding, making it resonate with immaterial soul stuff. Until the beginning of your next turn, your weapon gains the effects of the ghost killer weapon fusion. At 17th level, it deals an additional 1d6 spirit damage.

name: Restorative Chatter
text: Frequency once per day Requirements You must have at least three allies within 30 feet who you can communicate with. Your body physically heals when you can communicate with your allies. You can choose if your communication with allies is auditory or visual, and this action gains that trait when used. You gain fast healing equal to half your level for 1 minute. While Restorative Chatter is active, if you no longer meet the requirements, this fast healing ends.

name: Restorative Shapeshifting
text: Frequency once per minute Trigger You use Change Shape. You renew and reinforce your body with elements of your new form. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level (minimum 1) that last until the end of your next turn.

name: Retrotech
text: You might not remember your past, but some part of you has an innate understanding of the basic layout and user interfaces of ancient pre-Gap technology. You become trained in your choice of Computers or Crafting. If you're already trained in both, you instead become trained in a Lore skill related to technology. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge checks using Computers, Crafting, or Piloting to identify ancient technology designed before the Gap.

name: Return to Roots
text: You expand the ways organisms can thrive in adverse settings. You can cast and once per day each as 3rd-rank primal innate spells.

name: Return to the River
text: You have a soul-deep connection to the River Between. When you're in mortal peril, the River Between beckons you home and into its embrace. When you would die, you don't. Instead, you are encased in a cocoon of golden solar energy and disappear, teleporting across the galaxy to the River Between. [[/gmr 2d6 #days]]{2d6 days} later, this chrysalis hatches, and you emerge fully healed in a random location along the River Between in the Diaspora.

name: Reunite
text: Frequency once per hour Requirements You and your bonded partner are on the same planet. With a centering breath, you fill your mind with thoughts of your bonded partner and will yourself to their side. You teleport into an unoccupied space of your choice adjacent to your bonded partner. If there is no adjacent space available, you teleport into the closest unoccupied space.

name: Revitalized by the Drift
text:
The Drift revitalizes your spirit and restores your vitality, physically healing your wounds. If you rest for 10 minutes while within the Drift, you gain Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier × your level. This is cumulative with any healing you receive from Treat Wounds.

Once per hour, you can focus or meditate on your inherent connection to the Drift. This is a 10-minute activity that has the concentrate and exploration traits. When you do, you're treated as if you'd rested for 10 minutes while in the Drift, save that the number of Hit Points you regain from this feat is halved.

name: Revivification Protocol
text: Your nanites are programmed to automatically revive you.

name: Ride
text: When you Command an Animal you're mounted on to take a move action (such as Stride), you automatically succeed instead of needing to attempt a check. Any animal you're mounted on acts on your turn, like a minion. If you Mount an animal in the middle of an encounter, it skips its next turn and then acts on your next turn.

name: Ride the Breath
text:
Frequency once per day

You concentrate your breath into a powerful line and then evoke your entire body into the energy or matter from your breath weapon, traveling along with the attack. Creatures in a line with a length up to 120 feet take 18d6 damage of your heritage's associated damage type with a  save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. You rematerialize at the other end of the area. While your movement can still trigger reactions, most reactions typically won't have an effect on you while you are lightning, fire, and the like unless the reaction would counteract Ride the Breath or the GM determines it would affect the surging line of breath itself.

name: Ride the High
text:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You are under the effect of a beneficial emotion effect with a duration of at least 2 rounds, or a beneficial emotion effect from a bardic composition cantrip with a duration of 1 round, and the duration would end.

You ride the rush of emotion, holding it in your heart for just a little longer in order to keep the benefits that come with that emotion from fading. Extend the duration of the effect on you (and only you) by 1 round. You can't use Ride the High to continue the effect if it ends for a reason other than its duration expiring, such as if it is dispelled, or if the bard uses another composition cantrip.

name: Ride the River Between
text: Reaching across space, you connect with the River Between and seize a fragment of its solar stream, inundating the battlefield in golden light and solar energy. This trickle of the River Between fills a type:line|distance:100 that is 10 feet in diameter, starts from your square, and remains for 1 minute. Once the river forms, you can move to any square within the river (this movement does not trigger reactions). The area is bright light and counts as a vacuum for the purposes of a sarcesian using their energy wings. Non-sarcesians in the area when you use Ride the River Between, or who later enter the area, must succeed at a fortitude|against:class-spell save or become Dazzled for 1 round (1 minute on a critical failure). Creatures affected by this ability are temporarily immune for 24 hours. The DC of this save is equal to the higher of your spell DC or class DC.

name: Rift Strike
text: You tear a rift in space to strike an enemy. As a 2-action activity, make a solar manifestation Strike against any creature within 60 feet, bypassing concealment and cover.

name: Rip Current
text: You have a mystical connection to the powerful currents of Kalo-Mahoi and their interactions with the blooms, and you've learned to call upon them to wash powerful outsiders away through portals between planes. You gain Banishment as an 8th-rank primal innate spell that you can cast once per day. You can cast the spell targeting up to 10 willing creatures, who treat the results of their Will save as two degrees of success lower.

name: Rip, Tear
text: Your skull plates or teeth have grown sharper over time, or you have painstakingly carved them to do maximum damage when using them in combat. Your unarmed jaws attack now inflicts 1d6 persistent bleed damage on a successful hit (double on a critical hit). If your weapon damage ever increases, the number of dice for your bleed damage also increases by the same amount.

name: Rising Nightmare
text:
You can draw out nightmares again and again, and when you slay a creature, you can use its death as fuel for more nightmares. You can use your Agonizing Despair innate spell from Invoke Nightmare once per hour instead of once per day. Additionally, you can use the Raise Nightmare reaction.

Raise Nightmare: Frequency once per day

 Trigger You kill a foe

Effect You transform the foe's death into a waking nightmare for one of that foe's allies. You cast your Agonizing Despair innate spell on one of the dead foe's allies, even if you have already previously cast it in the last hour.

name: Rising to the Challenge
text: Trigger You critically fail a skill check. Requirements You're not in a combat encounter. Whether you're boogying down in a dance-off or striving for the highest score on a test, you treat any challenge as seriously as a fight to the death. Reroll the triggering skill check and use the second result.

name: River Swimmer
text: Your aquatic heritage makes you a powerful swimmer. Your swim speed increases to 35 feet and you can hold your breath for 5 minutes.

name: Road Roller
text: The slopes and roads of Hibb are kept in phenomenal condition, and you've mastered the bantrids' method for cleaning the roads for one another. You Stride. You clear through any squares of non-magical difficult terrain (but not greater difficult terrain) in which the source of the terrain could be crushed, such as dense undergrowth, or swept aside, such as debris or rubble.

name: Robust Core
text: Your design is one of the most common ones among your kind, and for good reason; it's robust, durable, and scalable. This gives you incredibly versatility in your development. You gain a general feat of your choice, and you must meet the feat's prerequisites.

name: Robust Recovery
text: You learned folk medicine to help recover from diseases and poison, and using it diligently has made you especially resilient. When you Treat a Disease or a Poison, or someone else uses one of these actions on you, increase the circumstance bonus granted on a success to +4, and if the result of the patient's saving throw is a success, the patient gets a critical success.

name: Rocket Boosters
text: Your drone gains a fly Speed of 20 feet and the Activate Thrusters action (two actions, once per 10 minutes): it Strides twice through creatures' spaces, dealing 5d6 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex vs your class DC; crit fail also knocks prone); damage increases by 1d6 per 2 levels.

name: Rocket Jump
text: Requirements You're wielding an area (burst) weapon. You fire your weapon as you jump, using the explosion to propel yourself to new heights or just out of a situation more dangerous than an explosion. You make an Area Fire and then Leap, using your weapon to add a status bonus to the distance traveled equal to double the burst of your weapon. You must be somewhere within the area of the weapon's area attack, but you don't have to save against the effect of your attack. Movement made as part of this action doesn't trigger reactions, though Area Fire still triggers them normally.

name: Rodnarth Survivor
text: When anyone asks how tough you are, all you have to say is, "I'm from Rodnarth." You've survived more extreme disasters than most can count, and your body has adapted to danger by storing a small reservoir of primal energy from the fonqon trees. The first time each day you would die because of the dying condition, your body draws on this reservoir, and you instead survive. Your remain at 1 Hit Point, and your dying value becomes 0, but you gain a wounded value equal to 1 less than the dying value that would normally kill you (typically Wounded 3).

name: Role Repertoire
text: Frequency once per day You've played many roles and picked up a surprising amount of eclectic knowledge while preparing to play them. Roll any [[/act recall-knowledge skill=performance]] check using Performance instead of Lore.

name: Roll Model
text: You've made your foot orb into a living work of couture art, becoming what young bantrids often call a baller. Whether you've incorporated it into stunning performances as a diva or use it to impress others who might not have even encountered a bantrid before, people can't help but admire your taste and style. You either become trained in Diplomacy and gain the Group Impression skill feat, or you become trained in Performance and gain the Impressive Performance skill feat. If you're already trained in one of these skills, you must take the other one and can choose from either skill feat. If you're trained in both skills, you become trained in a different skill of your choice instead and can choose from either skill feat.

name: Roller Coaster
text: Your above-average control over your foot orb offers you the extra spin you need to coast effortlessly. When you Step, you can move 10 feet instead of 5. This enables you to Step into and within difficult terrain as long as you can meet the extra movement cost.

name: Rolling Charge
text: You combine your rolling movement with a strike. When you Stride at least 20 feet in a straight line, you can make a melee Strike at the end of that movement without taking a multiple attack penalty.

name: Root Access
text: You have cracked the root access of arcane magic itself. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.

name: Rubbery Body
text: Your body is rubbery, and you bounce against surfaces. When you fall, reduce the falling damage you take as though you'd fallen half the distance. In addition, you gain the Bounce Back reaction.

name: Rugged Survivalist
text: You have experience surviving in some of the most extreme situations in the galaxy. You gain the skill feat. In addition, you can perform other downtime activities while you as long as they're feasible in your environment, such as finding raw materials to or Earning Income using Survival by live streaming your foraging.

name: Ruin Delver
text: You're fascinated by the ancient ruins scattered across Lajok's surface and orbit. Whether you're a scrapper harvesting materials for reuse, an innovator looking for a unique technological wonder, or a scholar hoping to glean secrets of the past, you enter these ancient sites, heedless of the danger. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to find hazards, to skill checks to disable hazards, to AC against attacks made by hazards, and to saves against hazards.

name: Rumormonger
text: While anyone can try to start a rumor, you can influence rumors even across large settlements within the course of a single day. You can use the Diplomacy skill to influence rumors as a downtime activity, spending at least 1 day of downtime to manipulate the spread, tone, or content of a rumor as you see fit. The GM determines the DC to influence a rumor based on the size of the community, how perceptive or invested the community members are, and any efforts by other rumormongers. The DC typically starts with at least DC 15 (the simple trained DC) for a small village and increases to at least DC 20 (the simple expert DC) for a town, at least DC 30 (the simple master DC) for a city, and at least DC 40 (the simple legendary DC) for a metropolis.

name: Run Hot
text: Requirements You're wielding an area weapon. You hold down the trigger and push your weapons to their absolute limits with a ceaseless barrage of firepower. Area Fire twice with the required weapon, ignoring the unwieldy trait of your weapon. Creatures in the area of the second Area Fire attack gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their save. After you use this action, your weapon must cool off and can't be used until after your next turn or until you take any amount of cold damage.

name: Run, Cowards!
text: You use your weapon to help corral panicked enemies. An enemy who critically fails a save against your Area Fire or Auto-Fire is Fleeing for 1 round.

name: Running Reload
text: You can reload your weapon on the move. You Stride, Step, or Sneak, and then Interact to reload a single weapon.

name: Running Shot
text: Requirements You're wielding a gun. You rush forward, firing a precisely aimed shot at your enemy while you're on the move. Aim and then Stride up to your Speed. At any point during this movement, you can make a ranged Strike with the gun you're wielding.

name: Running Shot
text:

You rush forward, firing a precisely aimed shot at your enemy while you're on the move. and then Stride up to your Speed. At any point during this movement, you can make a ranged Strike with the gun you're wielding.

name: Rush of Adrenaline
text: Frequency once per hour Trigger You succeed at a saving throw. You know that nothing in life is guaranteed, and you feel invigorated every time you overcome the challenges life throws at you. You're certain that you'll live to see another day. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 minute. If you critically succeeded on the triggering save, you are also Quickened during your next turn and can use your extra action only to Stride or Strike.

name: Sacred Space
text:
Your planar infusions are warded with heavenly energies, protecting those resting within them from evil and helping them recover. Nonevil allies within your planar infusion regain twice the normal amount of Hit Points from resting and gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against spells and other magical effects, which increases to a +2 status bonus on saving throws against chaotic or evil effects.

Effect: Sacred Space

name: Sacrificial Shell
text: Trigger An attack, spell, or effect would deal damage to you. Requirements Your shell isn't broken. An ijtikri's shell is tough enough to discourage foes from striking vital organs, but you're brave enough to literally block attacks head-on. You gain resistance equal to your Constitution modifier plus your level against all damage from the triggering attack or effect. After resolving the effect, your shell is broken, during which time you are Clumsy 1 and lose your resistance to precision damage granted by your mantle ability. The first time per day that someone successfully uses the Medicine skill to Treat your Wounds while your shell is broken, their efforts also repair your shell. Your shell is also repaired fully when you rest for 8 hours.

name: Sacrificial Shell (Gnarefuroid)
text: Your shell represents an incredible collection of priceless objects, but your life is worth more than your precious baubles. If you have a shell and would die, you instead gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level that last for 1 minute. Your shell breaks, leaving hazardous terrain in a centered on you that deals ] damage equal to half your level for each square a creature moves through. Whether you use the shards of your broken shell or new materials, rebuilding a new shell is a downtime activity that takes 8 hours.

name: Safemode Spell
text: [one-action] If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals damage and lacks the death or void trait, that spell gains the nonlethal trait.

name: Sales Pitch
text: You've perfected the art of convincing others to see things your way. You can use {Business Lore} or {Corporate Lore} to Make an Impression and, on a success or critical success, you shift your target's attitude one step higher. Whether or not Make an Impression is successful, the target becomes temporarily immune to Sales Pitch for 24 hours.

name: SALVO
text: You've attached a nervous system–integrated weapon mount to your LFAN that you can activate to efficiently fire an arc of electricity. This Semi-Autonomous LFAN Version Omega (or SALVO) deals ] damage (basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC). After using SALVO, you can't use it again for 1d4 rounds. At 15th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d4.

name: Sanctified Shell
text: The writing on your shell has evolved to become a divine script, either to a deity or to a philosophy unto itself. Depending on the spell you selected for Repository of Divinity, you become sanctified and gain either the holy or unholy trait (holy for Summon Celestial, or unholy for Summon Fiend). Your Fire Breath gains the sanctified trait, and you can choose to deal spirit damage instead of fire damage.

name: Sanctuary Kin
text: Your magical spark wards your allies, protecting them from attacks. You can cast Sanctuary as a 1st-rank divine innate spell once per day. You can cast the spell as a reaction triggered when your bonded partner is the target of an attack, as long as your partner is within 40 feet and you can perceive them and their attacker. If you do, the spell has a range of 40 feet and can target only your bonded partner.

name: Sanguine Wellspring
text: Frequency once per day You channel some of the power of your blood into your spellcasting abilities to help support them. You regain 1 Focus Point, up to your usual maximum.

name: Sapping Psychic
text: As your connection grows, you become adept at pulling energy out of the world around you. You gain Discharge and Earthbind as 3rd-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these primal innate spells once per day.

name: Sarcesian Lore
text: You've taken the lessons of your people to heart. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Arcana and Piloting. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Sarcesian Lore.

name: Sarcesian Weapon Familiarity
text: You're accustomed to fighting from afar—really far! You gain access to weapons in the sniper group and all uncommon weapons with the sarcesian trait. You have familiarity with weapons in the sniper group and all weapons with the sarcesian trait—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons, and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons. At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

name: Savvy Architect
text: You understand the intricacies of architecture, especially the construction of sturdy tunnels and buildings. You become trained in Crafting. If you're already trained in Crafting, you instead gain the Specialty Crafting skill feat for architecture. You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to notice dangerous structures. This bonus applies to checks to discover mechanical and environmental traps incorporated into walls, doors, ceilings, or other parts of a structure. If you aren't using the [[/act seek]] action or searching, the GM automatically rolls a secret check for you to notice hazards incorporated into a structure anyway. This check doesn't gain your normal circumstance bonus.

name: Saw it Coming
text: Trigger You're about to roll initiative. You read the demeanor, body language, and instinctive tics of your foes as easily as you read a comm unit, allowing you to react a moment before those around you and gain an edge in the coming battle. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your initiative roll, and you can immediately do one of the following: Interact to draw a weapon, Step, or Stride.

name: Scare to Death
text: You can frighten foes so much, they might die. Attempt an Intimidation check against the Will DC of a living creature within 30 feet of you that you sense or observe and who can sense or observe you. If the target can't hear you or doesn't understand the language you are speaking, you take a –4 circumstance penalty. The creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute. Critical Success The target must attempt a Fortitude save against your Intimidation DC. On a critical failure, it dies. On any other result, it becomes Frightened 2 and is Fleeing for 1 round. The critical failure effect has the death trait. Success The target becomes frightened 2. Failure The target becomes Frightened 1. Critical Failure The target is unaffected.

name: Scatter Thoughts
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You're targeted by a mental effect. You can shield your mind by using similar techniques that your ancestors once mastered to escape the Swarm. You block the intruding effect by scattering your thoughts, making you immune to the triggering mental effect for the next minute.

name: Scattering Fire
text: Your overwhelming onslaught scatters enemies like leaves in the wind. When you Shoving Shot, all creatures in the area attempt the Fortitude save to avoid forced movement, rather than just your primary target.

name: Scavenger's Eye
text: You can find resources where others see trash. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Survival to Subsist and can find useful components in nearly any environment.

name: Schooled in Secrets
text: Your understanding of hidden lore goes deeper than most. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Occultism checks to Recall Knowledge about secret societies, cults, and occult organizations.

name: Scion of the Fonqon Trees
text: While all fonqugons are children of the fonqon trees, you're a rare fonqugon whose gestation took place over the course of 17 days instead of the typical seven, which often occurs when a fonqon tree is in especially dire circumstances. As such, you're much more connected to the trees' primal magic than a typical fonqugon. Choose one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this cantrip as a primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Fonqugons must adapt to meet any challenge or threat that arises, and your magic is equally adaptable. By spending 1 day of downtime in a natural environment with any trees, you can change the cantrip you chose with this feat to a different primal cantrip. Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain into this feat.

name: Scope Sight
text: Viewing your marks through a scope is as instinctive as opening your eyes. Whenever you Aim, you can Interact to Activate a sight weapon upgrade.

name: Scorched Earth
text:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You are touching the ground.

Pressing against the ground to build up friction and heat, you rush forward and then scorch the earth around you. You Stride. At the end of your Stride, all creatures in a 60-foot emanation, including those that are burrowing 10 feet or less below the surface of the superheated ground, take 8d6[fire] damage with a Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a critical failure, they are also Enfeebled 1 for 1 minute. At 18th level, the damage increases to 9d6, and at 20th level, the damage increases to 10d6.

name: Scorching Lifeblood
text: Frequency once per day You accelerate the blood in your veins, charging latent magical energies within. For 1 minute, any adjacent creature that touches you, deals piercing or slashing damage to you, or hits you with a melee unarmed attack takes 3d6 fire damage.

name: Scout's Warning
text: You alert allies to danger. When you Scout, you can grant your allies a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls instead of just yourself.

name: Scramble Tech
text: With a thought, you can infect a technological creature or device with a short-lived virus, causing the object to glitch and malfunction. You can cast Discharge as a 3rd-rank divine innate spell twice per day.

name: Scrap Shield
text: You've incorporated detritus and adhesive resin to your body to build temporary layers to your shell. As part of your daily preparations, you create either one commercial or one commercial from detritus and your excretions. This shield can't be sold, repaired, upgraded, or altered in any way, and it disintegrates when you next make your daily preparations. You can use the reaction with this shield.

name: Scrapper's Barricade
text: You gain the general feat. You can Barricade using resin and hazardous debris from your own body. Any attack that fails to hit you while you have cover from this barricade destroys it, dealing |options:area-damage] damage to each creature in a originating from the barricade with a basic Reflex save against the higher of your class or spell DC. You must spend 10 minutes collecting new debris and resin before you can make another barricade in this way. Special You can use Adhering Acid on your barricade to make any creature that fails a Reflex save against your barricade Clumsy 1 until the start of your next turn.

name: Scrapper's Ingenuity
text: You take great delight in breaking down objects to their component parts so they can be rebuilt into something new. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Thievery checks to Disable Device and Pick Lock. Whenever you successfully Disable Device, you harvest useful parts from the device for future use, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus on your next Crafting check to Craft or Repair. If the device you disabled was of a level higher than your own, this bonus increases to +2.

name: Scrounge For Food
text: You're highly skilled at making a succulent meal out of whatever you find lying around. You gain the Additional Lore feat for Cooking Lore. You can use Cooking Lore in place of Survival to [[/act subsist skill=cooking-lore]]. Additionally, you gain the Seasoned skill feat.

name: Scrub Psyche
text: Trigger You or an ally fail a save against a mental effect while within your quantum field. You scrub all traces of the triggering effect from the target's mind. The target rerolls their saving throw against the triggering effect and must use the second result, even if it's worse.

name: Scrupulous Stalker
text: Frequency once per round You quickly scan your surroundings for threats. You Seek. If you use electromagnetic sense, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check.

name: Scurry to Safety

name: Search High and Low!
text: You alert your allies to look for enemies and Hidden things in a stressful situation, coordinating their efforts so they can do so more efficiently. Until the beginning of your next turn, you and your allies gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Seek. As your envoy level increases, increase the bonus to +3 at 7th level, +4 at 12th level, and +5 at 17th level. Effect: Search High and Low! Lead by Example If you used two actions, Seek. Each of your allies within 100 feet who can sense you can also immediately Seek as a reaction.

name: Seasoned
text: You have extensive experience preparing food and drink. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Crafting checks to prepare meals and a +1 when using prepared food to Aid an ally.

name: Second Chance
text:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a saving throw.

After a fatal mistake, you turn back time to allow yourself to try again. Reroll the triggering saving throw, taking the second result.

name: Secondary Directive
text: Requirements Your last action this turn was issuing a 2-action directive. You follow-up your issued directive with an understood order by attacking a notable foe. Make a Strike. If the Strike hits, the target is affected by a 1-action Get 'Em.

name: Secret-Keeper
text: You're astonishingly good at keeping secrets. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Lie when it involves protecting a secret you believe is only known by 10 or fewer people. When you use Deception to [[/act lie]], you don't take a penalty to Deception checks while subject to a spell or effect that would compel you to tell the truth. Whenever you're subject to an effect that attempts to extract a secret from you, including any effect that would read your thoughts or make you controlled, you can attempt to counteract the effect using your Deception modifier as the counteract modifier, with a counteract rank equal to half your level (rounded up). You can attempt to counteract each effect only once per round.

name: Secrete Numbing Saliva
text: Frequency once per hour Requirements Your last action was a successful Strike with your stomach-mouth jaws unarmed attack. Your stomach-mouth secretes numbing saliva into your target, exposing them to the poison. Numbing Saliva (injury, poison) Saving Throw fortitude|against:class-spell (the higher of your class or spell DC) Maximum Duration 6 rounds Stage 1 Clumsy 1 (1 round) Stage 2 clumsy 1 and Suppressed (1 round) Stage 3 Clumsy 2 and suppressed (1 round)

name: See the Pattern
text: Frequency: once per day You spend 10 minutes going over clues you've learned about an investigation to draw a line to a possible solution. Choose a creature you've met and interacted with or studied for at least an hour, or a mystery that you've been investigating for at least a day, and ask a question about that topic that wouldn't normally fall under the purview of . The question must be specific and answerable, as determined by the GM. Some examples include, "Did the tech entrepreneur really kill his assistant?" or "Was the hacker collective responsible for the data theft?" You gain a flash of insight that allows you to know whether or not your line of thinking is on the right track, such as figuring out who to ask next, though you don't receive a definitive answer to your question. The GM determines your flash of insight.

name: Seedling Reincarnation
text: When you die, a seed sprouts from your body. The seedling is a copy of you lacking any of your memories, though it has vague memories of your relationships and might feel fond of your allies or distrustful of your enemies. Over 1d6 weeks, the seedling grows into a miniature version of you with the same attributes and abilities (but Small instead of Medium). Over 1d6 months, you grow to your original size. A new seedling germinates in you over 10 years; if you die again before then, the seedling dies too.

name: Seedpod Lure
text: You grow a floating secondary seedpod you can use to fool other creatures. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Create a Diversion or Feint. Once every 10 minutes, you can deploy this lure as a move action. It remains deployed for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it. Any creature targeting you with an attack must attempt a flat|dc:5; on a failure, the creature hits the seedpod lure instead of you, destroying it. A new one grows after 10 minutes of rest.

name: Seedpod Surveillance
text: Once per day, you can deploy your seedpod as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. When deployed this way, your seedpod can travel up to 200 feet away from you, with a fly Speed of 20 feet. Moving the seedpod is a free action, which you can take once per turn, and you can sense through it in all directions as if using your normal senses. After 1 minute, the seedpod returns directly to you at its normal Speed.

name: Seemingly Random Study
text: Who says topics can't be randomly connected? Whenever you attempt a check to , you can roll the Lore skill you gained from Maze Lost with a –3 circumstance penalty instead of rolling with a normally applicable skill.

name: Seismic Sensitivity
text: You've spent significant time underground, and as a result, your antennae are particularly sensitive to vibrations. You gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.

name: Self-Destruct
text: Two actions (your turret is deployed within 100 feet): your turret deals 1d6 piercing and 1d6 fire damage to all creatures in a 20-foot emanation (basic Reflex vs your class DC) and is destroyed. The piercing damage increases by 1d6 every 2 levels.

name: Self-Repairing Exocortex
text: Your drone or turret gains fast healing 5. If it takes electricity damage, this fast healing deactivates until the end of your next turn.

name: Sense Abnormalities
text: You possess an uncanny sixth sense for ambient magic. You can sense the presence of magic auras as though you were always using a 1st-rank Detect Magic spell. This detects magic in your field of vision only. When you Seek, you gain the benefits of a 3rd-rank detect magic spell on things you see (in addition to the normal benefits of Seeking). You can turn this sense off and on with a free action at the start or the end of your turn.

name: Sense Abnormalities
text: You possess an uncanny sixth sense for ambient magic. You can sense the presence of magic auras as though you were always using a 1st-rank spell. This detects magic in your field of vision only. When you , you gain the benefits of a 3rd-rank detect magic spell on things you see (in addition to the normal benefits of Seeking). You can turn this sense off and on with a free action at the start or the end of your turn.

name: Sense Emotions
text: You can detect the emotions of others, though you lack the ability to sort out the complexities of these emotions. You gain emotion sense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. This means you can detect and determine the location of creatures that possess emotions. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks when using the Seek action to find Hidden or undetected creatures within the range of your emotion sense who's under an emotion effect, such as rage, the frightened condition, or any spell with the emotion trait.

name: Sense Life
text: You can detect the vital essence of creatures. You gain lifesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. This means you can sense the vital essence of living and undead creatures within range. You can distinguish between the vitality energy animating living creatures and the void energy animating undead creatures, much as sight distinguishes colors.

name: Sensitive Antennae
text: Your antennae are covered in fine hairs that make them more sensitive to psychic vibrations than most. You gain thoughtsense as a vague sense with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your antennae to determine if a creature is within range. Your thoughtsense detects only thinking creatures, so a creature that's unthinking or otherwise immune to mental effects can't be perceived using your thoughtsense. This doesn't give you the ability to read or understand their thoughts. At 9th level, this becomes an imprecise sense.

name: Sensitive Rhinophores
text: You possess a pair of rodlike structures that let you taste the air or water around you, making you alert to the presence of others via scent. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet; this range increases to 60 feet when you're underwater. The GM will usually double the range if you're downwind or downstream or halve the range if you're upwind or upstream.

name: Sentinel
text: You're trained to stand guard. You gain the benefits of taking cover when you stand watch, and you can wear medium armor without reducing your Speed during a watch.

name: Septocular
text: You've learned to grow additional eyes all over your body, enhancing your visual processing and the range of your eyesight. When you use Change Shape, you can choose to gain all-around vision until you change forms again. During this time, you take a –3 circumstance penalty to Deception checks and Deception DCs to Impersonate a different ancestry, unless the ancestry you are Impersonating normally has seven or more eyes.

name: Sepulcher
text:
Your entombing crypts can transform someone into a stone monument of their former selves. If a creature ends its turn within a crypt from your Entomb ability, it must attempt a Fortitude save; this is an incapacitation and transmutation effect.

This slow effect ends immediately when the creature leaves the crypt or the crypt is destroyed. However, if the slowed condition ever becomes so high that they are unable to act, they are permanently Petrified, requiring a stone to flesh spell or similar magic to return to flesh.

Critical Success The creature reduces any slowed condition it gained from the crypt by 2.

Success The creature reduces any slowed condition it gained from the crypt by 1.

Failure The creature is Slowed 1, as its body begins to petrify. If they were already slowed from this effect, increase their slowed value by 1 instead.

Critical Failure As failure, except the creature is Slowed 2 or increases its slowed value by 2 if it was already slowed from this effect.

name: Sequester Form
text: Frequency once per minute Trigger You're targeted by a mental effect. You can shield your consciousness by blocking one of your neural networks from the others, cutting yourself off from the identity until it's safe. You Change Shape and become immune to the triggering mental effect. You are no longer immune and the mental effect continues to affect you if you Change Shape into any form that shares an ancestry with that form before the duration of the mental effect expires.

name: Serpentine Scurry
text: 1 to 3 You've learned to make use of your exceptional balance and your ankles that can rotate 180 degrees to run in almost any direction without warning, easily throwing off the expectations of any potential predators. You Stride for each action you use to Serpentine Scurry. If you change directions after moving 5 feet or more, any further movement you make as part of Serpentine Scurry doesn't trigger reactions based on movement. Special If you have the skill feat, you can instead Stride, [[/act high-jump]], or [[/act long-jump]] for each action you use to Serpentine Scurry.

name: Serum Crafting
text: You can synthesize medicinal serums and compounds. You can use Crafting to create medicinal serums and healing compounds at half the normal crafting time.

name: Serum Sponge
text: You can slowly inject a serum or spell ampoule into your foot orb as a 1-minute activity, storing it to be absorbed by your body later. You can have only one serum or spell ampoule in your body at a time. You can activate and consume the absorbed fluid by squeezing your orb with your cilia without needing a free hand. An injected serum or spell ampoule left in your foot orb is gradually absorbed by your body and is consumed without any effect after 24 hours.

name: Seven-Eyed Scrutiny
text: Your brain efficiently processes each of your eyes' input, creating composite images that reveal what would otherwise remain hidden. When you [[/act seek]] or use the Search exploration activity, you gain the benefits of the See the Unseen spell until the end of your next turn.

name: Shadow Walk
text: When you move from concealment to concealment or from cover to cover, enemies must succeed at a Perception check against your Stealth DC or lose track of you entirely (you become undetected).

name: Shake it Off
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You fail a saving throw. Your mental and physical fortitude allow you to resist disastrous harm. You reroll the triggering check, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse than your first roll. Unless you roll a critical success, you become until the end of your next turn as you shake off the ill effects.

name: Shambling Corpsefolk
text: Most creatures mistake you for a mindless, shambling zombie or even a lifeless corpse, and you've learned how to use your sepulchral appearance to your advantage. You gain the Feign Death feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus when using Deception to roll initiative if you are Impersonating a corpse when combat begins.

name: Shameless Request
text: Shameless requests are your specialty. When you Request something, you reduce any DC increases for making an outrageous request by 2, and if you roll a critical failure for your Request, you get a failure instead. While this means you can never cause your target to reduce their attitude toward you by making a Request, they eventually tire of requests, even though they still have a positive attitude toward you.

name: Shape Ice
text:
Frequency once per hour

You reshape a cube of ice or snow you touch, up to 10 feet across, causing it to take a new form. This form can't include intricate details or parts, but has the rough shape you determine. Any creature standing atop the ice when you reshape it must attempt its choice of an Acrobatics check check or a Reflex save against the higher of your class DC and your spell DC. On a failure, it falls Prone atop the ice, and on a critical failure, it falls off the ice entirely and then falls prone.

name: Shape Statue
text: You use the power that animates your body to reshape your living stone and transform into one of your comrades. That comrade must be a common Medium-sized humanoid ancestry prevalent where your unit fought (typically in Veskarium space). While these disguises resemble specific individuals, the age of most animate enshrined vesk makes it challenging to find anyone who has personally met any specific enshrined warrior. If you've fought alongside enough or otherwise formed a close bond with a member of your party, your GM might allow you to transform into them as well. Using Shape Statue counts as creating a disguise for the Impersonate use of Deception, but without a holoskin or similar disguise, you take a penalty to imitate a non-constructed ancestry. You can remain in your new form indefinitely, but you revert to your base form after 1 hour of unconsciousness or 1 minute after death.

name: Share Pain
text: You distribute injury across your bond. When a bonded ally within 60 feet takes damage, you can use your reaction to split that damage equally between you and them (minimum 1 each).

name: Share Quantum Aura
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes You temporarily share your quantum field with an ally. You cause your quantum field to emanate from an ally you can see instead of yourself. The ally gains all the benefits of your quantum field, and your warp spells originate from your ally instead of you until your quantum field deactivates. If you cast warp spells at other targets, you must still have line of sight to the target, but the spell originates from your ally for purposes of determining its range and line of effect.
