text:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You temporarily share your quantum field with an ally. You cause your quantum field to emanate from an ally you can see instead of yourself. The ally gains all the benefits of your quantum field, and your warp spells originate from your ally instead of you until your quantum field deactivates. If you cast warp spells at other targets, you must still have line of sight to the target, but the spell originates from your ally for purposes of determining its range and line of effect.

name: Shared Reverb
text: Trigger You take mental damage or fail a save against a mental effect. The connections that your horn-cones form are bidirectional, which has left you sensitive to psychic attacks, but you can repurpose your vulnerability into a weapon. The source of the triggering effect takes mental damage equal to your weakness to mental damage.

name: Sharpshooter
text: Your ranged Strikes against the target of your Aim using the required ranged weapon deal an additional 1d4 precision damage until the end of your turn. This damage increases to 2d4 at 6th level.

name: Shatter Spell
text: [one-action] You don't just defuse enemy spells, you shatter them. If your next action casts dispel magic and you successfully counteract the target, one creature in the spell effect's space takes force damage equal to 1d4 x the target's counteract rank (basic Reflex save vs your spell DC); a matching damage-type trait changes force to that type.

name: Shattering Impact
text: You pour all your effort into making a single attack with your solar weapon that's so powerful it shatters the weapon. Strike with your solar weapon. The Strike deals one additional weapon damage die. Your solar weapon shatters and must be manifested to continue using it. Graviton-Attuned On a hit, the target takes a –10-foot status penalty to Speed until the start of your next turn. Effect: Shattering Impact Photon-Attuned On a hit, you additionally deal persistent fire damage equal to half your level, rounded up.

Photon-Attuned On a hit, you additionally deal persistent fire damage equal to half your level, rounded up.

name: Shearing Beak
text: Powerful muscles anchor your beak, enabling you to take devastating bites out of any target you can immobilize. You gain a beak unarmed attack that deals ] damage. Your beak is in the brawling group and has the backstabber, grapple, razing, and unarmed traits. However, the beak is awkward to deploy as a weapon. You take a –2 circumstance penalty to beak Strikes against targets that aren't Grabbed, helpless, Prone, or Restrained. Even if an effect increases your melee reach, your beak's reach can't exceed 5 feet.

name: Shed Skin
text: Frequency once per hour Trigger You attempt to Escape. You rapidly shed a layer of your skin and slip away from a tight or sticky situation, living to fight (or flee) another day. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on the triggering Escape, and on all attempts to Escape for 3 rounds. If the triggering Escape was successful, you can additionally Stand or Step (or Stride up to your Speed on a critical success).

name: Shedding Flurry
text: Trigger You're struck by a critical hit from a melee attack. Reacting quickly to danger, your body shakes and vibrates, causing you to shed some fur that can throw off the attacks of even the most experienced warrior. Attempt a flat. If you're successful, the attack becomes a normal hit.

name: Shell Fortress
text: Your reinforced shell provides exceptional cover. When you take cover behind your shell, you gain a +3 circumstance bonus to AC instead of the normal +2.

name: Shell Magic
text: The minerals constituting your mantle gradually absorb primal energy that you can extrude and shape. Choose one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this cantrip as a primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

name: Shell Shower
text: Frequency once per round Whether you got tired of getting hit in the face or slipping on bullet casings in the middle of a fight, you've learned how to redirect your weapon's spent ammunition or terrain warping vented energy while firing off a barrage. After you make an Area Fire or Auto-Fire attack with a weapon, make any number of squares adjacent to you difficult terrain. If a square was already difficult terrain, it instead becomes greater difficult terrain. Any difficult or greater difficult terrain created by this action remains in place until cleared.

text:

Whether you got tired of getting hit in the face or slipping on bullet casings in the middle of a fight, you've learned how to redirect your weapon's spent ammunition or terrain warping vented energy while firing off a barrage. After you make an or attack with a weapon, make any number of squares adjacent to you difficult terrain. If a square was already difficult terrain, it instead becomes greater difficult terrain. Any difficult or greater difficult terrain created by this action remains in place until cleared.

name: Shell Slam
text: You use your shell offensively. You gain a shell Strike (1d6 bludgeoning, shove trait) that you can use while retracted, and the attack doesn't end your retraction.

name: Sheltering Limbs
text: Your limbs and trunk grow strong and thick enough to shield your allies from danger. You can share your space with up to one willing ally. While an ally is sharing space with you or occupying an adjacent square, your ally gains the benefits of lesser cover. The ally can Take Cover to increase the bonus to standard cover.

name: Sheltering Mucous
text: You fill the nooks and crannies of your armor with a thick mucous that helps you feel more comfortable. You don't become Fatigued if you sleep while wearing armor. You gain the Mucous Spurt reaction.

name: Shield Block
text: You snap your shield into place to ward off a blow. As a reaction when hit by a physical attack while your shield is raised, you reduce the damage using your shield's Hardness, but both you and the shield take any remaining damage.

name: Shield Companion
text: Requirements You have an ally within reach. You've studied the defensive tactics of squires and chroniclers who have found that the best form of defense is to protect your more capable allies. You Raise a Shield to give an adjacent ally the circumstance bonus from your shield to their AC instead of you as long as the selected ally remains adjacent to you. These benefits last until the start of your next turn or until you're no longer adjacent to your ally, whichever happens first. If you have the Shield Block feat, you can trigger Shield Block when you have your shield raised and the selected ally would take physical damage from an attack. You gain no bonus from Raising your Shield this way and can't Shield Block if you would take damage.

name: Shielded Turret
text: Your turret provides cover rather than lesser cover, and Taking Cover behind your turret provides greater cover.

name: Shifter's Eye
text: You are a master at spotting other people in disguise. When you come within 10 feet of a creature that is disguised, transformed, or Impersonating a specific creature, the GM rolls a secret Perception check for you to realize that the creature is disguised, even if you didn't spend an action to Seek against that creature.

name: Shifter's Feint
text: You suddenly change your appearance to create an opening for your next attack. Change Shape and Feint. You gain a circumstance bonus to your Deception check to Feint equal to the number of steps between your sizes when you Change Shape (+1 if you are one size smaller or larger, +2 if you are two sizes smaller or larger, and so on). Regardless of the results of your check, each creature who observes you Change Shape is temporarily immune to Shifter's Feint for 1 minute.

name: Shifter's Orientation
text: Your malleable body makes it easier for you to reposition and rebalance yourself. Once every 10 minutes, when you Change Shape, you can gain the effects of the Reorient cantrip.

name: Shifter's Reach
text: You can stretch your body into long tentacular limbs to strike enemies from further away. For 1 minute, increase your reach when you're delivering touch range spells and making unarmed Strikes to 10 feet. This doesn't change the reach of your melee weapon attacks.

name: Shifter's Shove
text: You use the explosive momentum of shifting to help push a creature away from you. Change Shape into a larger size and Shove. You gain a circumstance bonus to your Athletics check to Shove equal to the number of steps between your sizes when you Change Shape (+1 if you are one size larger, +2 if you are two sizes larger, and so on).

name: Shifter's Squeeze
text: You can easily contort and resize your limbs to squeeze into smaller spaces. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics. If you are already trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the Quick Squeeze feat.

name: Shifting Plates
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You fail a Fortitude or Reflex saving throw. Your chitin can shift and overlap in unpredictable ways, protecting you when you're unable to protect yourself. You can reroll the triggering saving throw, using the second result even if it's worse.

name: Shifting Smuggler
text: When you Change Shape, you can Conceal an Object inside a cavity in your body or Interact to grab an object stored inside your body. You can store up to four items of light Bulk or less if you are Large, three items of light Bulk or less if you are Medium, or two items of light Bulk or less if you are Small. If you Change Shape into a smaller-sized body, the excess items fall to the ground in your square. None of these items can have a dimension longer than 1 foot.

name: Shiny
text: Your personality shines bright in a galaxy of stars. You become trained in Performance (or another skill if you're already trained in Performance), and you gain a +3 circumstance bonus on checks to for Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Performance checks.

name: Shirren Lore
text: Your ability to adapt to various beliefs instills you with knowledge of many cultures. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the general feat for Shirren Lore.

name: Shobhad Ferocity
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, but not immediately killed. Centuries of living on a brutal and unforgiving planet has endowed many shobhad with an implacable will to survive despite debilitating injuries. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, and your Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2 condition increases by 1.

name: Shobhad Lore
text: You're well-versed in the stories of your people. You become trained in Nature and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example) you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Shobhad Lore. Special If you have the urban shobhad heritage, you also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Ysoki Lore.

name: Shobhad Special
text: Requirements You have at least one hand free and are wielding a two-handed ranged weapon that doesn't have the area trait in your inactive hands. Invented by a talented shobhad sniper over a thousand years ago, the so-called "shobhad special" is a devastating maneuver that is only possible by a creature with the shobhad-neh's unique combination of size, strength, extra limbs, and cultural sniping techniques. Much to your pride, you're one of the few who have mastered it. Attempt a fist Strike against a creature at least one size smaller than you. If the attack is successful, you deal no damage but the target is immediately thrown up to 30 feet in a direction of your choice. Then, Switch Hands and make a ranged Strike against the target with the required weapon; the target is Off-Guard against this Strike. Regardless of whether this Strike is successful, the creature then falls Prone in whatever space is appropriate based on your throw. Special If you have the Titan Wrestler skill feat, you can use Shobhad Special against creatures up to your size, or up to one size larger than you if you're legendary in Athletics.

name: Shobhad Spirit-Blessed
text: You come from a line of shobhad spiritualists attuned to the whispers of the little spirits that encircle all things. Choose a 1st-rank divine or primal spell, either a common spell or another to which you have access. You can cast that spell once per day as an innate primal spell.

name: Shobhad Weapon Familiarity
text: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the shobhad trait. You have familiarity with weapons with the shobhad trait, plus the cryopike, fangblade, and hammer. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons. At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

name: Shockwave Pulse
text: You gain the Shockwave Pulse mod (grenade, weapon): the item releases a pulse of force on use. Area items knock prone all creatures that fail their save; otherwise a damaged creature is knocked prone unless it succeeds a Fortitude save vs your class DC.

name: Shooting Star
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes You launch yourself across the battlefield, emulating the brightest shooting stars. You Stride up to twice your Speed in a straight line. You're Concealed during this movement.

name: Shore Scuttle
text: Requirements You have at least one hand free. Your powerful limbs help anchor you to surfaces, allowing you to pull yourself through shallows and even lean your body almost parallel to the ground without falling over. You can choose to fall Prone. You then either [[/act crawl]] 10 feet (if prone) or Stride up to your Speed (if not prone), ignoring difficult terrain caused by shallow water. If you're prone, you can then Stand. Special If an ability (such as the Nimble Crawl skill feat) allows you to Crawl more than 10 feet as an action, you can instead Crawl up to that distance when you Shore Scuttle.

name: Shot on the Run
text: Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon. By preparing your weapon while on the move, you ready yourself to fire a salvo as soon as you're in position. Stride up to your Speed, and then Area Fire or Auto-Fire.
